reason: Document B addresses the late rent upfront, which is my biggest concern, and groups the concrete commitments—like the automatic bank transfer on the 1st—into a clean, easy-to-read offer. Document A feels a bit pushy with the "Here is why I think this is a good deal for you" list, and pointing out that a new restaurant saves $40,000 on the hood actually reminds me how easy it would be to re-lease the space if they leave.
